approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves fresh molecular graphs from scored survivors and fits two predictors using only the current session. A fixed tree model learns raw score differences between ordered pairs of accepted molecules; averaging each accepted reference label plus its predicted difference supplies the active location for every fresh candidate. A count-fingerprint Gaussian process supplies the retained sampled residual and the mean-based eligibility rule. Purchases update the full archive, the top survivors and later breeding. The pair-model location has improved on its earlier single-reference version, but still predicts paid outcomes worse than the GP.
approach.novelty: Add one chronological learned location weight. Before each announcement, choose the convex combination of the two existing predictors that minimizes squared error on all earlier paid prospective predictions, then hold that weight fixed throughout the batch. This lets real prior errors determine how much pair prediction reaches purchase decisions. No completed same-Parent siblings are listed in the brief; the scheduled siblings change directional reciprocity, the scalar model class or residual dependence. This intervention changes only the consumer of the existing two locations. A weight of zero is allowed and will be reported as GP-only behavior, so correction of the pair-only route cannot be mistaken for evidence of useful pair contribution.

observed_bottleneck: The code Parent n-ff10f4d5e7f3 always routes purchases with its uniformly averaged raw pair-model location even though the retained GP predicts the same paid labels more accurately. All 435 fits/pools and 4350 original paid joins are complete: pair-only MSE 0.008649387924947863 versus GP 0.0054658416803000385. This is a measured competence mismatch in the location consumer, not a fit failure. Preserve its earlier success versus passive single-incumbent prediction: MSE 0.00918329073879438 fell to 0.008649387924947863, 364 purchase sets and 784 paid identities changed, and its certified complete code-Parent macro increased by 0.022186684530005312 to 0.5470301211919261; ten endpoint cells improved, five declined, and all three seed macros rose. Its mechanism_result=confirmed, falsifier not triggered, conditional contribution positive and finalized task_safe=true remain intact. The earlier raw-pair-versus-GP prediction on n-7e9f57600099 remains refuted. The reciprocity sibling of that earlier code Parent, n-93efcfa0f760, retained a small complete paid-error improvement yet failed its separate endpoint prediction, with paired delta -0.0038813612303220113 and finalized task_safe=false. Neither result meets the literal formal-Anchor criterion. The frozen chronological audit, independently reconstructed from every original Parent prospective pool/feedback/trajectory join, gives mixture MSE 0.0054752398831109245, still above GP, with zero/interior/one weights in 307/124/4 of 435 batches. These are read-only Parent-history calculations, not Child outcomes, alternative adaptive endpoints or a search over formulas. The useful, testable claim is correction relative to pair-only routing while measuring whether any paid pair influence remains. Full provenance is in policy/scratch/r0073-02-improve-L01/source-audit.json and policy/scratch/r0073-02-improve-L01/parent-reconciliation.json, which enumerate each original Search log and trajectory beside its seed/task audit; endpoint evidence also uses nodes/n-ff10f4d5e7f3/seed-0/summary.json, nodes/n-ff10f4d5e7f3/seed-1/summary.json and nodes/n-ff10f4d5e7f3/seed-2/summary.json. hypothesis: Implement the frozen chronological two-expert constrained least-squares location consumer. For every previous optimizer purchase j in this Objective Session, retain its predictions made before its label was revealed: a_j=mu_all,j, g_j=mu_GP,j and real accepted label y_j. Let d_j=a_j-g_j. Before the next announcement use float64 cumulative A=sum_j((y_j-g_j)*d_j) and B=sum_j(d_j*d_j), w=clip(A/B,0,1), with w=0 if no previous prospective records or B is exactly zero. Freeze this single weight for every purchase in the announced batch. The active raw-score location is g+w*(a-g), consumed with the exact original GP residual and original-GP-mean eligibility. Commit new sufficient statistics only after the whole announced feedback batch is observed, once per actual accepted identity. Initial records train the inherited experts but never this weight because they lack prior predictions. Equal weighting, no intercept, ridge, decay, learning rate, warmup, task threshold, pseudolabel or hindsight fit. This is a predictive-location mixture; it is not a new coherent posterior or uncertainty calibration.

finding_summary.headline: Prior-error weighting lowers pair-only prediction error and improves endpoints while retaining pair influence.
finding_summary.insights:
Learning from earlier paid errors corrected the pair-only route without collapsing every session to GP. Both borrowed elements operated: predictions were frozen before labels, and nonnegative squared-loss weighting used those earlier predictions. This is the declared two-expert, convex, batch-frozen adaptation; it carries none of the source papers’ empirical or statistical guarantees. The small pooled error advantage over GP is specific to this realized purchase stream, and it does not reverse the earlier raw-difference model’s refutation against GP. The historical Parent replay had different purchases and slightly worse mixture error than GP; it was not an adaptive endpoint forecast.

The important remaining limitation is the link between prediction and selection. Mixture ordering accuracy was 68.76%, above pair-only 64.86% but below GP 69.14%. On the 1,705 purchases selected only after replacing pair-only routing, mixture error was worse than the pair expert (0.010603 versus 0.010193). On the 1,027 purchases outside the GP set, it was also worse than GP (0.008073 versus 0.007031). Thus the average calibration gain does not establish that the newly chosen molecules were better buys, nor that retaining the pair expert improves endpoints over a GP-only adaptive run. A different ranking or surrogate model is the kind of method that could address this mismatch; its benefit is untested here.

Late search still mostly refines unsuccessful candidates: 261 of 2,175 late purchases beat their generating parents, compared with 273 for the code Parent, and late incumbent advances fell from 109 to 82. The molecular report supports local concentration rather than universal scaffold collapse: 1,874 typed scaffolds coexist with only six, six and eight generic scaffolds in three leading task-level sets. Large-molecule purchases fell from 607 to 245, but the tiny-fragment tail grew from eight to 62. Coherent core and linker proposal operators could address that limited access to alternatives at useful scale; neither their benefit nor chemical mediation is established. Unusual heteroatom bonds and unspecified stereochemistry remain. This result settles the registered routing-correction prediction and a positive finite-panel variant contrast, while leaving reliable benefit, pure pair contribution and the approach’s broader scope open.
finding_summary.results:
All 435 scheduled batches and 4,350 prospective prediction–label joins passed the chronology and arithmetic audit. Complete-stream mean squared error was 0.00891624 for the mixture, 0.01062409 for pair-only prediction and 0.00898426 for the GP. The registered strict improvement over pair-only prediction therefore passed. Error improved in 14 of 15 cells against pair-only and nine against GP; all three seed means improved against both. The weights were zero in 49 batches, interior in 382 and one in four. All zero-weight batches reproduced GP choices exactly. Positive pair influence remained: 1,027 purchases were outside the passive GP set, while 1,705 differed from the pair-only set. Every one of the 4,200 nonterminal purchases reached the next fit; the final 150 had no later fit opportunity.

The mean final score rose from 0.547030 to 0.565170, a certified paired gain of 0.018139 over the actual code Parent, exceeding the separate +0.002 development target. Eleven endpoint cells improved and four declined; two seed macros rose and the third fell by 0.000751. Seed dispersion fell from 0.024079 to 0.007309. The formal Anchor target remains 0.609030, and its literal criterion cannot be attained by this different-Parent experiment. No Child task-safety flag or margin was supplied.

molecular.headline: Aromatic ring systems with smaller size tails, more tiny fragments and heteroatom–halogen bonds, and no assigned stereochemistry.
molecular.overall_character: All fifteen original Child and fifteen published code-Parent Search trajectories were read, covering frozen seeds 0/1/2 and all five tasks. Each node supplies 4,350 accepted optimizer purchases and 150 initial observations. The numerical chemistry summaries exclude initials; the cell audits retain every row in evaluation order. These are purchased molecules, not the full unpurchased generator pools. No issued input is missing, and no objective is omitted. The frozen context separately certifies complete Child evaluation and complete code-Parent pairing with n-ff10f4d5e7f3 on seeds 0/1/2, without profile-mismatched seeds. All cells remain visible, including the adverse endpoint cells identified in per_task; no mechanism, contribution, node-ranking or chemical-utility judgment follows from this molecular reading. The output contains compact aromatic carboxamides, linked carbonyl heteroaromatics, aryl-substituted saturated amines, aromatic/bis-amide ring assemblies, and fluorinated carbonyl N-heterocycles. Digest ring-closure presence rates are 0.977–0.9977 and aromatic-token presence rates 0.9667–0.9954. Those are string-level molecule-presence counters, not perceived ring counts or aromatic-atom fractions. RDKit separately finds aromatic atoms in 4,270 purchases and an empty acyclic Murcko scaffold in 63. The structural chips describe recognizable organic motifs mixed with unusual local bonds and ring connectivity; they do not establish synthesis, stability, ADME, binding or safety. Child heavy-atom median/range are 30 and 1–118, versus Parent 33 and 1–120. Preserving both historical size conventions, Child counts at <=5, <=6, >=50 and >50 heavy atoms are 60, 62, 245 and 229, versus Parent 8, 8, 607 and 597. Smaller bulk size therefore coexists with an expanded tiny-fragment tail. Typed/generic Murcko scaffold counts, including the empty scaffold, are 1,874/1,095 versus Parent 1,969/1,240. Ring and topology diversity are real but do not imply equally broad local high-score chemistry. The source-defined radius-2, chirality-aware 2,048-count Morgan dot-product Tanimoto uses only unordered pairs within each task/seed cell or actual consecutive ten-purchase batch. Within-cell means are Child 0.624232 and Parent 0.652628; excluding <=6-heavy-atom fragments gives 0.641811 and 0.654981. Within-batch means are 0.706274 and 0.746456, or 0.726018 and 0.749127 after the same exclusion. These pair-count-weighted descriptions contain no cross-session pairs, and lower similarity is not a reward or a demonstrated benefit. Local graph flags find N–halogen bonds in 888 purchases versus Parent 760, O–halogen bonds in 422 versus 125, and O–O single bonds in 63 versus 59. Carbon-centred atoms with two double bonds occur in 84 purchases versus 276; the separate sulfur-centred counts are 176 versus 341 and are not interpreted as allene liabilities. Of the Child carbon-centred cases, 53 have the central carbon and both double bonds in perceived rings. A perceived cycle of at most four atoms whose atoms are all marked aromatic occurs in 175 purchases versus 294; that flag does not assert the small cycle or every bond is aromatic. Such patterns prompt questions about actual geometric and chemical realization, not declarations of impossibility. All 4,350 Child purchases lack nonzero formal charges, assigned tetrahedral configurations and specified double-bond geometry. RDKit identifies 5,714 unassigned tetrahedral centres in 2,646 molecules; Parent has 6,666 in 2,672 and the same absence of explicit states. Neutral depiction does not determine solution protonation. Top-87/bottom-87 denote descriptive score-ordered subsets of 870 purchases per task, with seed/evaluation tie breaking; all per-cell top/bottom-29 and final-ten summaries are retained. These subsets can concentrate in one seed and are not independent trials. Methods and complete paired cell records are in policy/scratch/r0073-02-improve-L01/molecular/chemistry-summary.json and the per_task citations. Source-defined descriptor provenance is nodes/n-ff10f4d5e7f3/molecular.json; policy/scratch/r0072-01-improve-L01/molecular/chemistry-summary.json; policy/scratch/r0072-01-improve-L01/molecular/inspect_chemistry.py. Reproduction helper: policy/scratch/r0073-02-improve-L01/molecular/inspect_chemistry.py. Original-to-copy mapping and preserved input hashes: policy/scratch/r0073-02-improve-L01/molecular/original-input-mapping.json. Original issued paths retain molecule-citation authority; copies add none. Completeness and adverse cells: policy/requests/r0073-02-improve-L01-molecular-assess-88cbf243e321ca52.json#context.comparison.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
